import { test } from 'node:test';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
test('acceptance: the engine unit restarts after a crash', (t) => {
  if (!(existsSync('/run/systemd/system') && process.env.NEVER === '1')) {
    t.todo('needs systemd');
    return;
  }
  throw new Error('would really run here');
});
